Challenges Faced by Clinics in Pakistan

Clinics in Pakistan face numerous challenges, including managing patient records, tracking inventory, and ensuring FBR compliance. These challenges can lead to inefficiencies, errors, and lost revenue.

Moreover, clinics must comply with FBR regulations, such as obtaining a Sales Tax Registration Number (STRN) and filing tax returns. Non-compliance can result in penalties and fines.

Phelix ERP understands these challenges and has developed a comprehensive POS system to address them.

Solution: Phelix ERP's POS System

Our POS system is designed to help clinics manage their operations efficiently, reduce errors, and increase revenue. With Phelix ERP, you can:

  • Manage patient records and appointments
  • Track inventory and supplies
  • Process payments and generate invoices
  • Ensure FBR compliance with our integrated tax management system
  • Generate reports and analytics to inform business decisions
  • Integrate with other systems, such as accounting software and patient management systems
